summary: This wiki page covers Spanish footballer Gerard Piqué, a centre-back for Barcelona and the Catalonia national team. It describes his youth career with Spain's under-19 side, which won the 2006 UEFA European Under-19 Championship, and his performances at the 2007 FIFA U-20 World Cup, where Spain was eliminated at the quarter-final stage.
one_line: Gerard Piqué is a Spanish centre-back for Barcelona whose youth career included the 2006 UEFA European Under-19 title and the 2007 FIFA U-20 World Cup.
key_facts: Gerard Piqué Bernabeu was born on 2 February 1987.
Gerard Piqué Bernabeu is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Barcelona and the Catalonia national team.
Piqué was a member of the Spain under-19 side that won the 2006 UEFA European Under-19 Championship in Poland.
In the 2006 final, Spain beat Scotland 2–1.
In the 2006 final, Piqué put in a strong defensive performance and hit the crossbar with a header.
In the 2006 final, Piqué provided Spain's second goal for striker Alberto Bueno.
Piqué played in the 2007 FIFA U-20 World Cup and started all six of Spain's matches.
Piqué scored in Spain's come-from-behind 4–2 victory over Brazil in the round of 16 at the 2007 FIFA U-20 World Cup.
Piqué missed the deciding penalty in the shoot-out against the Czech Republic.
Spain were eliminated at the quarter-final stage of the 2007 FIFA U-20 World Cup after losing to the Czech Republic.
